title: xylophragma xanthophyllum
intro: Xylophragma xanthophyllum, commonly known as "Bleeding Heart Tree," is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. The leaves and stem of Xylophragma xanthophyllum have been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits, such as wound healing and infection prevention. Xylophragma xanthophyllum is reported to contain bioactive constituents including alkaloids and flavonoids, which may exhibit therapeutic actions like antioxidant and antipyretic activities.
